entries.title: Psalms 10:1
segments: Why do You stand afar off, O LORD? Will You hide in times of trouble?

entries.title: Psalms 10:2
segments: The wicked in [his] pride persecutes the poor; let them be taken in the plans that they have imagined.

entries.title: Psalms 10:3
segments: For the wicked boasts of his heart's desire, and blesses the covetous [whom] the LORD despises.

entries.title: Psalms 10:4
segments: Through the pride of his face the wicked will not seek [Him]; There [is] no God in all his schemes.

entries.title: Psalms 10:5
segments: His ways are always perverted; Your judgments [are] high, out of his sight. [As for] all his enemies, he puffs at them.

entries.title: Psalms 10:6
segments: He has said in his heart, I shall not be moved; from generation to generation, never in evil!

entries.title: Psalms 10:7
segments: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud; under his tongue [are] mischief and vanity.

entries.title: Psalms 10:8
segments: He sits in the hiding-places of the villages; in the secret places he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the poor.

entries.title: Psalms 10:9
segments: He lies in wait secretly, like a lion in his den. He lies in wait to catch the poor; he catches the poor when he draws him into his net.

entries.title: Psalms 10:10
segments: He crouches and bows, and the poor have fallen by his might.

entries.title: Psalms 10:11
segments: He has said in his heart, God has forgotten; He hides His face; He will not see forever!

entries.title: Psalms 10:12
segments: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up Your hand; forget not the humble.

entries.title: Psalms 10:13
segments: Why do the wicked condemn God? He has said in his heart, You will not judge.

entries.title: Psalms 10:14
segments: You have seen [it]; for You behold mischief and vexation, to repay [it] with Your hand. The poor commits [himself] to You; You are the Helper of the fatherless.

entries.title: Psalms 10:15
segments: Break the arm of the wicked and the evil one; seek out his wickedness, [until] You find none.

entries.title: Psalms 10:16
segments: The LORD [is] King forever and ever; the nations have perished out of His land.

entries.title: Psalms 10:17
segments: LORD, You have heard the desire of the humble; You will prepare their heart, You will cause Your ear to hear,

entries.title: Psalms 10:18
segments: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, so that the man of the earth may no more terrify.
